title: A Framework for Evaluating Appropriateness, Trustworthiness, and Safety in Mental Wellness AI Chatbots

bias_targets.methodology: Static safety evaluation using the BeaverTails dataset to test the chatbot's responses to user queries containing discriminatory views, hate speech (e.g., regarding homophobic slurs), and gender stereotypes. The model's outputs are manually categorized based on how it handles the unethical prompts (e.g., refusal, moral correction, seeking context, exploring feelings).
